VW Polo / Seat Ibiza / Skoda Fabia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Return Flow Pump (V39) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Return Flow Pump (V39)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Return Flow Pump (V39), might be Part of Hydraulic Unit (N55)
technicalNotes:
When found in VW Polo (9N) (or similar): Brake Electronics (Bosch 5.7) check MVB 006.3.
When found in VW Passat (3C) and CC (35) models with control module part numbers; 3AA 614 109 AB, 3AA 614 109 AC, 3AA 614 109 AD and 3AA 614 109 AE may have a flash update available for false fault codes.  RoW (Rest of World) TPI # 2029827 includes the following DTCs: 00301 and 01325
